prompt.name: Arpenteur forestier
prompt.prompt: Create ONE finished 2D/2.5D fighting-game character sprite, ONE full body only, isolated on a truly transparent background. Single static neutral-ready pose facing screen RIGHT, three-quarter side view, head and feet both visible, feet on one common ground baseline. Portrait composition, complete silhouette with at least 5 percent transparent margin all round. Match the refined hand-painted game-sprite style and identity of the first standing figure in the reference, not the whole atlas. Clean solid outlines, precise material shading, readable anatomy and equipment attachments. Do not make a sprite sheet, pose variations, multiple characters, comparison layout, text, captions, UI, backdrop, floor, cast shadow, glow or atmospheric haze. The requested clothes are an original CQC costume, not an official released-game outfit. Preserve the same period-specific character and do not borrow another incarnation. THE FEAR from Metal Gear Solid 3, original Survive/forest costume “Arpenteur forestier”. Preserve his lean long-limbed adult body, angular weathered face, slicked-back grey hair and thin trailing ponytail from the reference, his unusual crouched alert silhouette and organic human identity. New practical grey-green forest textiles with short repaired sleeves, a light fitted shoulder-and-chest harness, compact bolt sleeves and short tied climbing cords at belt, small waterproof pouches. Keep a compact period crossbow held lowered along his near thigh, with its shape and attachments coherent. This is an ORGANIC human in survival clothes, not a cyborg or robotic replacement. Small original scars/tattoo accents may show at forearms; keep the face recognizable and the mouth naturally slightly open. No large camping tank/bedroll of the old generic survival variant, no extra limbs. One alert standing/hunched pose facing right.

visualReview.description: Organic forest-survival costume with light harness, short cords and bolt sleeves; no cyborg change.
visualReview.note: Physically viewed: lean organic adult, grey-green repaired forest textiles, light harness and lowered crossbow; no cybernetic transformation.
visualReview.limits: Original CQC design; no claim of official outfit or exact recovered historical pixels. Anchor is preliminary and may be refined in catalogue QA.
